title: Sweep crash-orphaned staged seed temp files at lichend boot
description: P3, pre-existing (wave-3 review of worker6-xyk3): a kill -9 between stage_private_seed temp creation (lichend.rs ~:1500) and publish cleanup leaks a 32-byte 0600 .id.seed.*.tmp forever; no boot-time sweep exists. Fix: at startup, unlink stale .id.seed.*.tmp in the state dir before provisioning.
